title: Rosemary Chicken with Orange-Maple Glaze
description: This rosemary chicken with orange-maple glaze recipe features chicken breasts, a rosemary rub, and an orange juice, white wine, and maple syrup sauce.

steps.text: Combine orange juice and wine in a small saucepan; bring to a boil. Reduce heat slightly; continue a low boil for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in maple syrup; continue a low boil until glossy and just slightly thickened, 5 to 6 minutes more, stirring frequently. Set aside.
Combine rosemary, salt, and black pepper in a small bowl; rub on both sides chicken breasts. Set aside.

Melt butter with olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken breasts, cover skillet, and sauté until lightly browned, about 5 minutes per side. Pour orange-maple mixture over chicken (mixture will boil and bubble). Reduce heat to a simmer; cover, and cook 10 minutes, basting occasionally, until chicken is cooked through and sauce turns into a rich, thick glaze.
